objective: formalize and fail-closed audit a non-degenerate NWP-predictability-to-SNR allocation before any G0-B denoiser is implemented or trained

already_inspected_before_freeze: the 267 G0-A out-of-fold N1 variance rows
eta=0.5 preliminary budget, monotonicity, positivity, retention, and log-SNR-shift summaries
exploration_disclosure.consequence: G0-B0 may establish implementation identity and feasibility only; its pass status is not evidence of denoiser or scenario-generation utility

not_authorized: a G0-B denoiser implementation or training run
validation, calibration, selection, R-SEEN, or final target access
selection of eta from reconstruction outcomes
a claim that reserve-then-water-fill improves diffusion
a claim that Gaussian reverse water-filling is methodologically novel

allowed_files: the frozen G0-B0 config and sidecar
the frozen G0-A result and sidecar

mode_registry.variance_source: G0-A outer-fold N1_variance; no refit occurs in G0-B0
mode_registry.weight_source: each day and group uses G0-A effective_rank divided by that day's sum over six groups
mode_registry.weight_interpretation: dimension-weighted Gaussian information and absolute posterior MSE

gaussian_reference.budget_contract: for every day and diffusion step, sum_k w_dk*I_allocated_dtk equals the corresponding IID budget exactly within tolerance
gaussian_reference.claim_boundary: this diagonal Gaussian reference defines allocation and diagnostics; it is not asserted to be the true wind residual law

allocation.name: reserve_then_water_fill
allocation.primary_eta_rationale: an outcome-independent symmetric contract: preserve half of each mode's IID information and reallocate only the other half
allocation.remaining_problem: min sum_k w_k*a_k*exp(-2*J_k), J_k>=0, sum_k w_k*J_k=(1-eta)*B_IID
allocation.solution: J_k=0.5*max(log(a_k/theta),0), with theta fixed by the remaining budget
allocation.solver: deterministic exact active-set enumeration in float64 log space
allocation.equal_variance_identity: if all six v_k are equal, every eta reduces exactly to IID

sensitivity.role: schedule interpretation only; no eta may be selected from future reconstruction or generation outcomes

audit.numeric_dtype: numpy.float64 after exact conversion of the registered float32 alpha_bar

go_no_go.GO_authorizes: freeze a separate G0-B tiny-denoiser protocol only; it does not authorize full diffusion training

result_must_record: config, evidence, schedule, runner, and allocation-module identities
primary budget, monotonicity, positivity, endpoint, retention, and shift diagnostics
each individual gate and final status
